evidence.excerpt: Machines execute in Besiege; position, velocity, trajectories and broken-component feedback guide revisions. Matched stage-wise comparisons use up to eight candidates per stage.

evidence.title: Official BesiegeField project
evidence.excerpt: Seven machine task families, scalar simulation outcomes, cold-start dataset and GRPO fine-tuning; project links the official code.

scope.zh: BesiegeField 在《围攻》中把组件、连接和驱动写成机器程序；比较单次生成与仿真反馈驱动的迭代/分层改造，覆盖七类机械任务。
scope.en: BesiegeField turns parts, connections and actuation into machine programs in Besiege, comparing one-shot generation with simulation-feedback iterative/hierarchical refinement across seven mechanical task families.

metrics.zh: 解析/空间/机器有效率；任务物理分数的均值、最大值；均值常仅在有效机器上统计。
metrics.en: Parse, spatial and machine validity; mean/maximum physical task score, with means often conditional on valid machines.

limits.zh: 闭环改造是在线环境交互；单次提交产物不等于键鼠游玩。原版关卡、战斗或多玩家协作均未由这些实验覆盖。EMNLP 接收为作者主来源声明。
limits.en: Closed-loop refinement interacts with the environment; one-shot artifact submission is not keyboard/mouse play. Original campaign, combat and multiplayer coordination are outside these experiments. EMNLP acceptance is an author-primary claim.

focus.zh: 仿真反馈驱动的机器构造与改造。
focus.en: Machine construction/refinement through simulation feedback.

scope.zh: 以 BesiegeField 脚本物理场景为准；非全游戏通关。
scope.en: Scripted BesiegeField physics scenes, not full-game completion.

introduction.zh: 把木块、轮轴和机械部件组装成载具或装置，在物理仿真中测试它们能否越过障碍、运送物体或摧毁目标，再调整结构和控制方式。
introduction.en: Assemble blocks, wheels and mechanical parts into machines, test them against physical obstacles or targets, then revise their structure and controls.

records.title: Compositional Machine Design as Program Synthesis with LLMs

task.zh: 构造行进或投石机器，并依据物理反馈改造。
task.en: Build movement/throwing machines and revise them from physical feedback.

observation.zh: 目标、场景、组件、DSL；仿真分数与轨迹/损坏等状态。
observation.en: Objective, scene, parts and DSL; simulator scores, trajectories and damage state.

action.zh: 生成/编辑组件连接与驱动的机器 DSL，再运行仿真。
action.en: Generate/edit construction/actuation DSL and execute simulation.

metrics.zh: 解析/空间/机器有效率；任务物理分数的均值、最大值；均值常仅在有效机器上统计。
metrics.en: Parse, spatial and machine validity; mean/maximum physical task score, with means often conditional on valid machines.

controls.zh: 同阶段最多八候选，分初始构造、无反馈改造、环境反馈改造。
controls.en: Up to eight candidates per stage: initial construction, blind refinement and environment-feedback refinement.

limits.zh: 限原文 Movement/Throwing 配置；本轮未运行，精确引擎/场景版本需锁定。
limits.en: Restricted to reported Movement/Throwing settings; not executed here and exact engine/scene release needs pinning.

basis.zh: 将功能目标分解为机构与连接，再用结果修改。
basis.en: Decomposes function into mechanisms/connections and revises from outcomes.

evidence.title: BesiegeField paper, sections 3–4 and appendix E
evidence.excerpt: Machines execute in Besiege; position, velocity, trajectories and broken-component feedback guide revisions. Matched stage-wise comparisons use up to eight candidates per stage.

evidence.title: Official BesiegeField project
evidence.excerpt: Seven machine task families, scalar simulation outcomes, cold-start dataset and GRPO fine-tuning; project links the official code.

evidence.excerpt: Introduces 140 engine-grounded tasks across 15 families.

evidence.title: Official GameCraft-Bench project
evidence.excerpt: Verifier replays submitted traces into gameplay evidence and scores hidden task rubrics; links official code.

scope.zh: 140 个 Godot 4 完整游戏生成任务，覆盖 15 个游戏家族；提交工程与可重放操作轨迹。
scope.en: 140 end-to-end Godot 4 game-generation tasks across 15 families; submissions include projects and replayable input traces.

metrics.zh: 启动门槛后，以机制、内容深度、功能视觉、艺术呈现四类 rubric 给分。
metrics.en: Launchability gate followed by rubric scores for mechanics, content depth, functional visuals and presentation.

limits.zh: 评价生成游戏产物，不是独立玩家代理的通关能力；家族名称不能直接变成商业游戏关联。
limits.en: Scores generated artifacts rather than a standalone player agent; genre families do not imply named commercial-game links.

evidence.title: GameEngineBench: Evaluating Coding Agents on Real C++ Runtime Environments
evidence.excerpt: 110 C++ implementation tasks in nine real Unreal Engine 5 projects, spanning networking, animation, UI, persistence and rendering plugins.

scope.zh: 9 个真实 Unreal Engine 5 工程中的 110 个 C++ 行为实现任务，含联机复制、动画、UI、存储与渲染插件。
scope.en: 110 C++ implementation tasks in nine real Unreal Engine 5 projects, spanning networking, animation, UI, persistence and rendering plugins.

metrics.zh: 编译且满足行为测试的 pass@1。
metrics.en: Pass@1 requiring compilation and behavioral tests.

limits.zh: UE5 是引擎；评估代码变更，不是 FPS/RTS 游玩。论文指向 Nitrode-Research/GameEngineBench，但本轮无法取回仓库页，未把链接当作已核验公开代码。
limits.en: UE5 is an engine; evaluates code changes, not FPS/RTS play. The paper points to Nitrode-Research/GameEngineBench, but its page could not be retrieved in this pass, so code availability is unconfirmed.

evidence.title: JAMER paper abstract and evaluation
evidence.excerpt: Verified Godot projects are separated into JamSet and a 300-project JamBench, with generation and completion tasks and SCS/BAS metrics.

scope.zh: JamSet/JamBench：从 Game Jam 项目筛得 8,133 个有效 Godot 工程，其中 300 个组成生成与代码补全评测。
scope.en: JamSet/JamBench contains 8,133 verified Godot Game Jam projects, with 300 forming generation/code-completion evaluations.

metrics.zh: 编译通过率、结构完整性 SCS、行为对齐 BAS。
metrics.en: Compilation pass rate, Structural Completeness Score and Behavioral Alignment Score.

limits.zh: 训练集与 300 项评测集需分开；运行行为验证针对生成代码。完整子项目归属未在本轮逐项展开。
limits.en: Training and the 300-project evaluation split are distinct; runtime verification evaluates generated code. Individual project/game membership was not fully expanded in this pass.

evidence.title: WebGameBench sections 1–3
evidence.excerpt: One generation attempt produces a locally served game, followed by browser interaction and evidence-grounded three-way quality labels.

scope.zh: 111 个浏览器游戏生成任务；从冻结结构化需求生成、部署并由真实浏览器交互验收。
scope.en: 111 browser-native game-generation tasks; frozen structured specifications are implemented, deployed and evaluated through browser interaction.

metrics.en: Move-matching accuracy, perplexity and skill-conditioned prediction coherence.

limits.zh: 核心论文协议是离线人类行为预测；可在线使用的模型不等于该论文报告了自主对局评测。
limits.en: The core reported protocol is offline human-behavior prediction; deployment as a bot does not itself establish a reported gameplay tournament.

focus.zh: 人类下一步预测与棋力一致性
focus.en: Human next-move prediction and skill coherence

evidence.title: ChessBench paper

evidence.title: Official ChessBench implementation

scope.zh: ChessBench提供Stockfish标注棋局，比较离线价值/着法预测、棋题及闭环对局。
scope.en: ChessBench provides Stockfish-annotated games for value/move prediction, puzzles and closed-loop chess play.

metrics.zh: 价值误差/排序相关、棋题准确率、锦标赛BayesElo和Lichess等级分。
metrics.en: Value error/rank correlation, puzzle accuracy, tournament BayesElo and Lichess rating.

limits.zh: 监督训练的专用Transformer，不应默认标为通用LLM或RL。固定数据与引擎/搜索预算分别控制；本轮未复现实验。
limits.en: Specialist supervised transformers are not automatically LLM or RL agents. Dataset, engine and search budgets must be controlled separately; no execution reproduced here.

focus.zh: 监督价值学习、棋题与对局策略
focus.en: Supervised values, puzzles and playing strategy

scope.zh: ChessBench提供Stockfish标注棋局，比较离线价值/着法预测、棋题及闭环对局。
scope.en: ChessBench provides Stockfish-annotated games for value/move prediction, puzzles and closed-loop chess play.

task.zh: 从指定开局与其他引擎对弈至结束或裁定，比较无搜索策略。
task.en: Plays from selected openings against engines until termination or adjudication.

observation.zh: 当前完整国际象棋局面及合法着法；模型使用FEN/棋盘编码。
observation.en: Current chess position and legal moves, encoded using FEN/board tokens.

action.zh: 选择并执行合法棋步，使棋局更新并轮到对手。
action.en: Executes a legal move and advances the board to the opponent’s turn.

metrics.zh: 对局胜/负/和及BayesElo；与离线棋题准确率分列。
metrics.en: Wins/draws/losses and BayesElo, separate from puzzle accuracy.

controls.zh: 官方脚本每对200局，抽取ECO开局并交换执子颜色；明确模型和对手搜索预算。
controls.en: The released example uses 200 games per pair, sampled ECO openings and swapped colors; model/opponent search budgets remain explicit.

limits.zh: 当前脚本包含Stockfish早停裁定；应固定引擎、检查点及裁定版本。没有核验Chess960协议，本单元不声称该泛化覆盖。
limits.en: Current code uses Stockfish early adjudication; pin engine, checkpoint and adjudication versions. Chess960 was not verified and is outside this unit.

basis.zh: 在规则约束下选择连续对弈着法，以实际对局结果评价策略质量。
basis.en: Selects rule-constrained moves over an actual match, with strategy evaluated by game outcomes.

evidence.title: Official evaluation instructions
evidence.excerpt: The repository provides actual tournament matches and BayesElo computation.

evidence.title: Official tournament implementation
evidence.excerpt: Samples ECO opening boards, swaps colors, advances legal moves and records game outcomes; uses Stockfish early adjudication.

evidence.title: Chessformer paper, Sections 4–5
evidence.excerpt: Maia-3 uses held-out human move matching; Leela-CF uses pairwise 200-game tournaments and 10,000 chess puzzles.

evidence.title: Official Maia-3 implementation
evidence.excerpt: Official human-move-prediction implementation linked by the Chessformer paper.

scope.zh: 统一国际象棋架构：Maia-3预测人类着法，Leela-CF进行策略对局与棋题评测。
scope.en: A unified chess architecture: Maia-3 predicts human moves while Leela-CF is evaluated in playing tournaments and puzzles.

metrics.zh: 人类着法匹配率、策略/价值准确率、棋题正确率及相对Elo。
metrics.en: Human move matching, policy/value accuracy, puzzle accuracy and relative Elo.

limits.zh: Maia-3人类模仿与Leela-CF竞技模型使用不同数据与目标；不能合成一个未经定义的统一成绩。
limits.en: Maia-3 human emulation and Leela-CF strength use different datasets/objectives and must not be merged into an undefined unified score.

focus.zh: 人类模仿、竞技强度和解释性
focus.en: Human emulation, competitive strength and interpretability

scope.zh: 统一国际象棋架构：Maia-3预测人类着法，Leela-CF进行策略对局与棋题评测。
scope.en: A unified chess architecture: Maia-3 predicts human moves while Leela-CF is evaluated in playing tournaments and puzzles.

records.title: Chessformer: A Unified Architecture for Chess Modeling

task.zh: Leela-CF策略头或价值选步模型，与其他无搜索/固定搜索设置引擎进行真实对局。
task.en: Leela-CF policy or value-based agents play actual games against other engines under specified search settings.

observation.zh: 当前棋盘及模型所需历史/状态辅助信息；不接收像素。
observation.en: Board position with model-specific history/state auxiliaries, not pixels.

action.zh: 选取策略头最高分着法，或评估合法着法并选择价值最高者。
action.en: Takes the highest-ranked policy move or selects among evaluated legal moves.

metrics.zh: 每对200局比赛后计算相对BayesElo；胜负和记录。
metrics.en: Relative BayesElo after 200 games per pair; win/draw/loss records.

controls.zh: 论文第5.2节区分策略选步和逐合法着法价值选步，主实验与消融独立锦标赛。
controls.en: Section 5.2 separates policy and per-legal-move value agents; main and ablation tournaments are separate.

limits.zh: 此单元仅第5.2节无搜索比赛；附录B的完整MCTS引擎计时比赛及Maia-3人类预测另列，不混用预算或指标。
limits.en: Limited to Section 5.2 searchless matches; Appendix B timed MCTS engines and Maia-3 human prediction are distinct protocols.

basis.zh: 在规则约束下选择连续对弈着法，以实际对局结果评价策略质量。
basis.en: Selects rule-constrained moves over an actual match, with strategy evaluated by game outcomes.

evidence.title: Chessformer Section 5.2 evaluation methodology
evidence.excerpt: Defines policy/value move selection and plays 200 actual games per pair to calculate relative BayesElo.

evidence.title: Scientific Reports open full text
evidence.excerpt: Uses a 4-by-9 placement game. The human dataset is not public; code is released at 4IAR-nns and 4IAR-improvements.

scope.zh: 用移动端4×9四连棋人类行为训练神经网络，并改进可解释认知模型。
scope.en: Trains neural networks on human mobile four-in-a-row behavior to refine interpretable cognitive models.

metrics.zh: 留出人类着法预测准确率、负对数似然及模型拟合差异。
metrics.en: Held-out human move accuracy, negative log likelihood and cognitive-model fit.

limits.zh: Peak原始行为数据按协议不公开；模型拟合和网络可向作者申请；没有将此分析当作Agent规划能力证据。
limits.en: Peak behavioral data are not public under the agreement; trained networks and fits are request-only. This analysis is not evidence of autonomous-agent planning capability.

focus.zh: 人类着法预测和认知模型改进
focus.en: Human-move prediction and cognitive-model refinement

scope.zh: 用移动端4×9四连棋人类行为训练神经网络，并改进可解释认知模型。
scope.en: Trains neural networks on human mobile four-in-a-row behavior to refine interpretable cognitive models.

records.title: Using deep neural networks as a guide for modeling human planning

evidence.title: Goldsmiths official published-paper record
evidence.excerpt: A survey of mixed-initiative methods for creating game content, with a catalogue of techniques and challenges.

scope.zh: 综述人机混合主动内容创作，覆盖关卡、资产和叙事工具。
scope.en: Surveys mixed-initiative content creation, including level, asset and narrative tools.

metrics.zh: 文献分类、典型技术和研究挑战；无统一游玩成绩。
metrics.en: Literature taxonomy, techniques and challenges; no unified playing score.

limits.zh: 综述中提到的游戏和编辑器不是本文实际评测游戏，不展开为在线任务。
limits.en: Mentioned games and editors are survey examples, not evaluated gameplay tasks.

evidence.title: Controllable 3D generators paper
evidence.excerpt: Introduces Minecraft-domain PCGRL generation tasks and controllability tests.

evidence.title: Official code
evidence.excerpt: The repository identifies the 2022 3D level-generator paper and includes generator training/inference/evaluation.

scope.zh: 在Minecraft体素域中训练RL关卡生成器，控制迷宫/地牢的路径和可玩性约束。
scope.en: Trains RL level generators in Minecraft voxel domains with maze/dungeon path and playability constraints.

metrics.zh: 生成质量、多样性、目标可控性与随机初始状态泛化。
metrics.en: Generation quality, diversity, target controllability and generalization over initial states.

limits.zh: RL动作编辑关卡而非控制Minecraft玩家，不计游玩在线任务或玩家控制能力。
limits.en: RL actions edit levels rather than control a Minecraft player; excluded from gameplay online tasks and player-control coverage.

focus.zh: 体素关卡生成与可控性
focus.en: Voxel level generation and controllability

scope.zh: 在Minecraft体素域中训练RL关卡生成器，控制迷宫/地牢的路径和可玩性约束。
scope.en: Trains RL level generators in Minecraft voxel domains with maze/dungeon path and playability constraints.

evidence.title: IEEE official abstract
evidence.excerpt: Compares bootstrapping, controllable/uncontrollable PCGRL and generative playing networks, evaluating playability, diversity and controllability.

scope.zh: 比较四类深度学习Sokoban关卡生成方法及改进。
scope.en: Experimentally compares four deep-learning Sokoban level-generation methods and modifications.

metrics.zh: 可解/可玩比例、关卡与解法多样性、控制混淆。
metrics.en: Playability/solvability, level/solution diversity and control confusion.

limits.zh: 评价关卡生成而非推箱子Agent；最终出版全文未在本轮取得，方法细节以可公开核对内容为限。
limits.en: Evaluates level generation rather than a Sokoban-playing agent; the final published full text was not obtained in this pass.

focus.zh: 关卡生成方法比较
focus.en: Level-generator comparison

scope.zh: 比较四类深度学习Sokoban关卡生成方法及改进。
scope.en: Experimentally compares four deep-learning Sokoban level-generation methods and modifications.

evidence.title: Utrecht author publication record
evidence.excerpt: Uses features from verbal communication and game metadata to predict whether Overwatch games are toxic.

scope.zh: 从原版Overwatch玩家语音音频特征和对局元数据预测毒性。
scope.en: Predicts toxicity from in-game voice-audio features and metadata of original Overwatch matches.

metrics.zh: 毒性分类预测及玩家体验关联；不是游戏胜率。
metrics.en: Toxicity classification and player-experience associations, not gameplay win rate.

limits.zh: 对应Overwatch而非Overwatch 2；人类语音数据不代表Agent操控或多Agent协作benchmark。
limits.en: Original Overwatch, not Overwatch 2; human speech data do not establish an agent-control or multi-agent-cooperation benchmark.

focus.zh: 人类语音毒性检测
focus.en: Human voice-toxicity detection

scope.zh: 从原版Overwatch玩家语音音频特征和对局元数据预测毒性。

evidence.title: Official ASE code

scope.zh: 从动作片段学习物理角色通用技能嵌入，用于新任务。
scope.en: Learns reusable physics-based character skill embeddings from motion clips for downstream tasks.

metrics.zh: 动作模仿、下游任务回报、起身和抗扰表现。
metrics.en: Motion imitation, downstream task returns, get-up and perturbation performance.

limits.zh: 剑盾是动画角色设定，不是具体商业格斗游戏；不计游戏游玩覆盖。仓库已提示弃用并指向MimicKit。

evidence.title: MaskedMimic paper
evidence.excerpt: Models physics-based character control as motion inpainting conditioned on masked poses, objects and text.

evidence.title: Official SMPL checkpoint card
evidence.excerpt: The shipped checkpoint supports masked motion constraints, not text control, and requires a matching MotionLib.

scope.zh: 用掩码动作补全统一稀疏关键帧、物体和文本条件下的物理角色控制。
scope.en: Unifies sparse keyframe, object and text conditioning using masked motion inpainting for simulated characters.

metrics.zh: 动作跟踪成功率与姿态误差；多种条件控制实验。
metrics.en: Motion-tracking success and pose errors, with multiple conditioning experiments.

limits.zh: 角色动画并非具体游戏游玩；当前公开SMPL检查点明确不支持文本控制，不能把论文所有模态当作现成可运行功能。
limits.en: Character animation is not a specific game-playing task. The current public SMPL checkpoint explicitly lacks text control; paper modalities are not all shipped features.

evidence.title: Author AI4Animation repository, SIGGRAPH 2022
evidence.excerpt: DeepPhase learns periodic features from unstructured motion datasets for character-motion synthesis.

scope.zh: 周期自编码器学习动作相位，用于实时双足/四足、舞蹈和足球运球动画。
scope.en: Periodic autoencoders learn motion-phase manifolds for biped/quadruped, dance and soccer-dribbling animations.

metrics.zh: 相位表示、动作重建、合成与检索表现。
metrics.en: Phase representation, motion reconstruction, synthesis and retrieval.

limits.zh: 足球运球是动作合成演示，未确认足球游戏规则、对手或比赛协议，不能映射为体育游戏benchmark。
limits.en: Soccer dribbling is a motion-synthesis demonstration without a verified football-game match protocol, opponent or scoring system.

records.title: DeepPhase: Periodic Autoencoders for Learning Motion Phase Manifolds

evidence.title: Official SuperPADL project
evidence.excerpt: Progressively distills RL experts into a language-controlled physics character policy trained on over 5,000 skills.

scope.zh: 渐进监督蒸馏结合RL专家，实现大规模语言指令物理角色动画。
scope.en: Progressive supervised distillation combines RL experts for large-scale language-directed character animation.

metrics.zh: 动作模仿质量、文本技能跟随与多技能转换。
metrics.en: Motion imitation, language-directed skills and skill transitions.

limits.zh: 论文描述实时角色动画创作；未确认具体游戏环境或官方独立代码发布，不计在线游戏任务。
limits.en: The paper concerns real-time animation authoring; no specific gameplay environment or official standalone code release was confirmed.

records.title: SuperPADL: Scaling Language-Directed Physics-Based Control with Progressive Supervised Distillation

evidence.excerpt: Official implementation linked by the project page.

scope.zh: 以扩散运动规划器与物理跟踪器闭环完成到点、击物、坐下与起立。
scope.en: Closes a loop between a diffusion motion planner and a physics tracker for reaching, striking, sitting and standing.

metrics.zh: 任务成功率、运动质量与开放/闭环基线比较。
metrics.en: Task success, motion quality and open-/closed-loop baseline comparisons.

limits.zh: 是动画任务规划与控制；并非有规则和对手的游戏benchmark，不把运动规划直接加入游戏Agent覆盖。
limits.en: Animation planning/control, not a game benchmark with rules and opponents; motion planning does not automatically enter game-agent coverage.

evidence.title: ICLR paper

metrics.zh: 状态匹配误差、样本效率、训练耗时和稳定性。
metrics.en: State-matching error, sample efficiency, training time and stability.

limits.zh: 主要方法使用解析物理梯度而非RL；不能因比较RL基线就标为RL算法。没有具体游戏游玩评测。
limits.en: The main method uses analytic physics gradients rather than RL; RL baselines do not make it an RL method. No named gameplay evaluation.

evidence.title: Official PHC implementation

metrics.zh: 动作模仿成功率、跟踪误差、恢复和实时性。
metrics.en: Motion-imitation success, tracking errors, recovery and real-time behavior.

limits.zh: 虚拟角色控制而非具体游戏玩家控制；视频/文本来源不使该策略成为VLM或LLM。
limits.en: Virtual-avatar control, not player control in a specific game; video/text motion sources do not make the policy an LLM or VLM.
